article.story: TULSA, Okla. -- — Chris Loofe led Tulsa with 18 points and sealed the victory with a layup with 37 seconds left as the Golden Hurricane knocked off Western Kentucky 67-64 on Monday. Loofe added nine rebounds for the Golden Hurricane (4-0). Macon Emory shot 5 for 8 to add 12 points. Jaylen Lawal finished with 11 points. Teagan Moore finished with 19 points and three steals for the Hilltoppers (3-2). Sharron Young added 16 points and four steals for Western Kentucky. L.J. Hackman had 11 points and two steals. Loofe scored seven points in the first half, and Tulsa went into the break trailing 40-26. Loofe scored a team-high 11 points for Tulsa in the second half, including the dagger shot in the final minute. Up next Both teams play next Friday. Tulsa plays Mississippi State, and Western Kentucky plays Richmond. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
